title: Leaf Values Left To Right
statement:
Collect the values stored in a binary tree's leaves from left to right.

Contract
- `root` may be null. Return an empty list for an empty tree.
- A leaf is a node with no left or right child.
- Return only leaf values, preserving the order in which they appear from the left edge of the tree to the right edge. Do not mutate the tree.

Examples
`leafValues(tree(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, null, 6))` => `[4, 5, 6]`
`leafValues(tree(7))` => `[7]`
`leafValues(null)` => `[]`
hints: First define exactly when a node is a leaf.
A preorder-style DFS can visit the left child before the right child.
Add a value only when both child references are null. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(h) stack space.
inputSyntax: Input: the tree in level order with null for missing children, for example: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, null, 6]
